P.name: Cultivation of War
P.text: Innate: Zaahen generates a stack of Determination for each enemy champion damaged by his basic attacks and abilities, lasting 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers, stacking up to 12 times. After the duration the stacks expire one more every 0.5 seconds. Determination: for each stack Zaahen gains bonus attack damage equal to 1.5% - 2.8% (based on level) AD; at maximum stacks the bonus is doubled. Periodically, if he would take lethal damage at maximum stacks, he refreshes its duration and enters resurrection for 4 seconds (invulnerable, untargetable, unable to act).

Q.name: The Darkin Glaive
Q.text: Active: Zaahen empowers his next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an uncancellable windup and gain 25 bonus range. On-attack he strikes the target twice; if the target was a champion, minion or monster he also heals himself (5-9% of his maximum health against champions, half against others). Each strike applies on-hit effects and can critically strike.

W.name: Dreaded Return
W.text: Active: Zaahen extends his glaive in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies hit. Upon reaching maximum range, all enemies hit are dealt physical damage (30-110 + 30% bonus AD), stunned for 0.25 seconds and pulled 225 units toward Zaahen. Range 850, width 140, missile speed 2900, pull speed 900, cast time 0.5.

E.name: Aureate Rush
E.text: Active: Zaahen dashes to the target location (up to 350, speed 900, no cast time). Upon arrival he flourishes his glaive to deal physical damage to nearby enemies (radius 375); enemies hit by the outer edge (beyond 200) are dealt 50% increased physical damage and bonus magic damage of 4-6% of the target's maximum health. 50 bonus damage against monsters.

R.name: Grim Deliverance
R.text: Passive: Zaahen gains 10-30% armor penetration. Active: Zaahen gains crowd control immunity over the cast time, then launches into the air to the target location (10-600, dash speed 2800). He slams his glaive down after a 0.6-second delay, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies (radius 550) and healing 33% of it for each champion hit. He is unable to act and has 50% damage reduction from the start of the cast.

P.name: Silver Stake
P.text: Innate: Locke's basic attacks deal 5 - 40 (based on level) (+ 10% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit, increased by 0% - 100% (based on target's missing health, 7.14% for every 5%, maximum at 70% missing health), up to 10 - 80 (based on level) (+ 20% AP).

Q.name: Ritual Nails
Q.text: Active: Locke hurls a nail in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit, slows them by 25% for 1 second and applies a stack of Soul Nails for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. Against targets with at least 2 stacks the slow is increased to 60%. Soul Nails detonation: 18-50 (+ 25-35% AP).

W.name: Soul Ignition
W.text: Active: Locke ignites his soul for 6 seconds, becoming ghosted and gaining 40% - 70% (based on level) bonus attack speed and 40% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus movement speed, decaying to 20% over 1 second after 1.5 seconds. During the effect he stores grey health equal to 100% of the post-mitigation damage he takes from enemy champions, up to a cap, plus the health spent on the ability's cost.

E.name: Ashen Pursuit
E.text: Active: Locke blinks to the target location, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies upon arrival. After a 0.1-second delay he empowers his next attack command within 4 seconds to gain 275 bonus range and dash in the target's direction, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies along the way and applying on-hit effects to the primary target.

R.name: Purgatory
R.text: Active: Locke throws a totem that travels to the target location over 0.5 seconds. After landing for 0.25 seconds the totem fires latching nails at nearby enemies: dealing magic damage, slowing them by 99% decaying over 2 seconds, revealing them for 1 second and marking enemy champions hit for 5 seconds. Marked enemies are executed below 10-12% of their maximum health.
